summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend (5/5): DELETE /api/auth/account fully erases user + projects + brand kits (post-delete /auth/me returns 401 and login with same email returns 401); unauth DELETE rejected; GET /api/analytics returns the exact required shape (total_projects, total_assets, status_counts {idea, branding, done}, type_counts, tasks {total, done}, 7-entry activity with date+count); POST /api/brand-kits with auto_generate=false + custom colors + style_rules returns EXACT provided values (verified via GET) and does NOT consume an AI generation (usage.generations_used unchanged). Frontend: (1) Onboarding welcome modal appears on first dashboard load with Get Started + Try a Template buttons; dismissing persists localStorage cf_onboarded='1' and modal does NOT reappear on reload; (2) Dashboard Quick Start includes Templates + Insights tiles that navigate to /templates and /analytics; (3) Templates screen renders category chips (Startup active by default) + 3 template cards; tapping SaaS Startup template opens /capture?seed=<idea>&mode=pitch with idea pre-filled and Pitch mode chip preset; (4) Palette Generator: 8 base swatches + 4 harmony chips (Analogous/Complementary/Triadic/Monochromatic-ish) update the 5-color preview live; Save as Brand Kit creates a kit with the generated palette and navigates to /brand-kit/<id>; (5) Analytics screen renders 4 stat cards (Projects, Assets, Streak, Tasks done), 7-day activity bar chart, Project Pipeline stacked bar with legend, Assets by Type section; (6) Delete My Account confirm modal on Profile: Cancel dismisses without deleting (URL stays /profile, cf_token retained); Delete everything on a throwaway signup account calls DELETE /api/auth/account, clears cf_token, redirects to /login, and subsequent login with the same credentials returns 401 (stays on /login). Regression: demo login still works, seeded projects + milestones still visible. NEW/OLD RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) still emitted — documented in iteration_1/2, no regression. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected in package.json.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over): migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx to silence RN-web deprecation warnings. Not blocking.

OPTIONAL: Consider showing an empty-state hint for the Studio Asset Library search/filter block when assets.length === 0 (currently the whole block is conditionally hidden — reviewer noted this is expected, but a discoverability improvement).
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/auth/account correctly cascades delete across users, projects, brand_kits, assets, payment_transactions, user_sessions collections — GDPR/CCPA compliant.

POST /api/brand-kits correctly gates AI palette generation behind body.auto_generate; when False the user-provided colors/style_rules/fonts are stored verbatim without calling ai.generate_palette or check_and_count_generation — verified via usage.generations_used before/after.
GET /api/analytics status_counts is pre-initialized with idea/branding/done keys guaranteeing shape stability regardless of project state — good defensive coding.

Profile doDelete now correctly calls api.deleteAccount() -> setShowDelete(false) -> await logout() -> router.replace('/login'). Prior iteration_2 logout-navigation issue was also fixed (Log out button uses same pattern).
seed_data_creation: Created several throwaway users during delete-account testing (tester+del_*@creatorforge.app and throwaway_*@creatorforge.app). All were self-cleaned by the DELETE /api/auth/account endpoint under test. Demo account (demo@creatorforge.app) was NOT touched. One TEST_CustomKit brand kit was created and deleted during the brand-kit test. One TEST_PaletteKit brand kit was created via the Palette Generator UI on the demo account and remains — main agent may want to delete it via /api/brand-kits/{id} if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 features verified end-to-end (backend + web frontend). Key testIDs: welcome-start-button, welcome-template-button, quick-templates, quick-insights, template-cat-<slug>, template-<id>, palette-back, base-swatch-<hex-without-hash>, harmony-<key>, hex-input, palette-name-input, save-palette-button, analytics-back, asset-search-input, asset-filter-all, asset-filter-<key>, download-all-button, delete-account-button, confirm-delete-button, cancel-delete-button, toggle-auth-mode, signup-name-input. No mocked APIs. Backend uses uuid string IDs and unified bearer auth. Preserve demo account.
